# KohDen International Pte Ltd

> Authorised Singapore distributor (since 2019) of DENSO, EXN, MOON and Hyper Power car parts. Supplies motor workshops; drivers buy and fit through authorised workshops.

- Trade counter: 7 Kaki Bukit Road 1, #01-15 Eunos Technolink, Singapore 415937. Mon to Fri, 9am to 5pm. Phone +65 6966 6565.

## Key facts
- DENSO Iridium Power spark plugs: S$24 each (KohDen list price). Iridium TT S$26 to S$36. Iridium SR S$22 to S$42.
- EXN engine oils 4L: S$80 (Carios, Extentios Hybrid); Molyracing S$40 to S$120 by size.
- MOON silicone flat and hybrid blades: S$30 to S$80.
- Hyper Power 12V sodium-ion batteries: B20 to D31 and L2 to L6, 700 to 1200 CCA; price on request.
